an4.269:1.1: [catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato …pe…] attanā ca pharusāvāco hoti, parañca pharusāvācāya samādapeti, pharusāvācāya ca samanuñño hoti, pharusāvācāya ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati. imehi kho …pe… [yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.] [catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato …pe…]
an4.269:2.1: attanā ca pharusāvācāya paṭivirato hoti, parañca pharusāvācāya veramaṇiyā samādapeti, pharusāvācāya veramaṇiyā ca samanuñño hoti, pharusāvācāya veramaṇiyā ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati. imehi kho …pe…
